acceptance.given: The Toolchain has prepared a Consumer Manifest and review has not started.

oracle.expected: Before review, a structural lifecycle check shows a non-empty, version-bound Consumer Manifest reconciled bidirectionally against the repository real-call surface, including VDD, Acceptance, and workflow-model-routing consumers, and records it as frozen.
forbidden: An empty Consumer Manifest is accepted.
A Consumer Manifest is frozen after review begins.
A Consumer Manifest remains mutable during review.
oracle.observable: The pre-review Consumer Manifest validation artifact reports the manifest entries, version binding, bidirectional call-surface reconciliation, and frozen-before-review lifecycle state.

acceptance.then: Only the complete, non-empty, version-bound, reconciled manifest frozen before review satisfies the lifecycle check.
acceptance.when: The Toolchain runs the Consumer Manifest lifecycle and call-surface reconciliation check before review.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Exercise the Consumer integration selector with empty, incomplete, post-review-freeze, and mutable-after-freeze manifest variants; each must fail the structural lifecycle check.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Require the Toolchain Consumer Manifest to be complete, non-empty, version-bound, reconciled bidirectionally with repository real-call surfaces including VDD, Acceptance, and workflow-model-routing consumers, and frozen before review begins.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserve existing replay receipt compatibility; an invalid manifest must not be frozen or published for review.

slice_hint.state_transition: prepared Consumer Manifest -> complete, version-bound, bidirectionally reconciled Consumer Manifest frozen before review
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The pre-review validation accepts only a non-empty Consumer Manifest reconciled bidirectionally with every repository caller, including VDD, Acceptance, and workflow-model-routing, and proves its frozen lifecycle state precedes review.

acceptance.given: The active Atomic Obligation set and its Exact Cover witness records are supplied to the S12 semantic compilation path.

oracle.expected: Every active Atomic Obligation has a required witness and bidirectional Exact Cover reports zero orphan obligations.
forbidden: A missing witness for any active Atomic Obligation.
An Exact Cover result that accepts an orphan obligation.
oracle.observable: The S12 test assertions inspect the compiled Exact Cover result and its per-obligation witness records, including the negative validator's missing-binding result.

acceptance.then: The compiled result preserves one required witness for each Atomic Obligation and rejects the witness-deficient negative case.
acceptance.when: Exact Cover is compiled or validated

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run the S12 selector with the exact-cover negative validator's missing reverse binding so the required failure is observed.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Compile and assess required per-Atomic-Obligation witnesses through the semantic atomic-recall path; the authored S12 selector asserts full bidirectional coverage and an executable missing-witness red result.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No persistent state or schema change; reverting restores the prior semantic witness assessment.

slice_hint.state_transition: Atomic Obligations without independently checked witnesses become a compilation failure instead of an accepted Exact Cover result.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The S12 selector proves a witness for every active Atomic Obligation, zero orphans, and rejection of the missing-witness negative case.

acceptance.given: Aggregate evaluation receives the complete required Matrix Case/input/subject execution set with one required execution intentionally absent.

oracle.expected: The aggregate evaluation reports failure and identifies the missing required execution; it never returns success for the incomplete set.
forbidden: The aggregate reports success while any required Matrix Case, input, or subject execution is missing.
oracle.observable: Executed aggregate result and its missing-execution diagnostic are captured from the matrix evaluation invocation.

acceptance.then: Execute the aggregate check after removing one required execution from an otherwise complete Matrix Case set.
acceptance.when: Any required Matrix Case execution is missing.

failure_intents.selector_intent: The aggregate accepts an incomplete Matrix Case execution set or omits the missing-execution failure.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Ensure aggregate evaluation fails closed whenever any required Matrix Case, input, or subject execution is absent.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserve existing aggregate result schema and failure semantics; rollback only the missing-execution guard and its test.

slice_hint.state_transition: complete execution set -> one required execution missing -> aggregate failure with diagnostic
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The aggregate result is non-success and explicitly reports the absent required execution.

acceptance.given: An invalid-package adversarial case is supplied to the Toolchain success evaluator.

oracle.expected: Evaluation returns a non-success outcome for the invalid-package case.
forbidden: The invalid-package case is classified as success.
A stale or unrelated receipt is used instead of executing the invalid-package evaluation.
oracle.observable: The evaluator's current result contains a non-success verdict tied to the invalid-package input.

acceptance.then: The invalid-package case is rejected as success and produces a current non-success verdict.
acceptance.when: When an invalid-package case is evaluated by the Toolchain replay/evaluation path.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Ensure invalid-package inputs cannot yield a success verdict; emit a current non-success evaluation result.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Keep existing replay result schema and verdict compatibility; revert only invalid-package success handling and its S24 test.
